title: 795. All Paths From Source to Target

examples.explanation: Two ways reach the final vertex.
Five routes connect start to finish.
The lone edge is the answer.

hints: Depth-first search from 0 carrying the current path naturally enumerates every route.
Append a copy of the path once the final vertex is reached, then backtrack.
Adaptation: the nested input maps to int_array_2d and the nested output maps to int_list_2d in this judge.
